# Cost & opportunities in misspecified predictive regressions

Research and presentation material on the topic of quadratic errors in predictive regressions. Joint work with [**Romain Deguest**](https://sites.google.com/site/romaindeguestsite/research).
:::

## Theoretical contributions

- [**Comparisons of methods**](files/PRs/comparison.nb.html): tests between integral formulae and Monte-Carlo simulations. Requires the [R functions](files/PRs/R_functions.R) and [C functions](files/PRs/c_functions.cpp).
- [**Sensitivity analysis**](files/PRs/sensitivity.nb.html): impact of persistence, forecasting horizon and sample size on loss / R^2^.
- [**Univariate learning**](files/PRs/univariate.nb.html): comparison between PRs and univariate learning, that is, regression on lagged values of the process.

## Empirical results

All empirical results are based on this [**RMarkdown notebook**](files/PRs/emp_func.Rmd) and this [**function file**](files/PRs/r_func.R). The [**data**](files/PRs/data_exp.RData) (.RData format) is based on that of Welch and Goyal (2008) plus one variable from Novy-Marx (2014). Sources of the analyses:

- [**Impact of rho_y**](files/PRs/impact_rho_web.nb.html)
- Value of [**economic constraints**](files/PRs/constraints.nb.html)
- Aggregate [**variance forecasting**](files/PRs/variance.nb.html)
